selection: Within each dataset, manifest indices3/19/35; independent of prediction correctness
recommendation: Gemini as practical multimodal evidence-graph generator; GPT is more conservative and a useful visual/subtitle comparator; Omni not preferred under this implementation
limitations: Six clips visually inspected via all8 input frames and available subtitles; audio was supplied to Gemini/Omni but not independently listened to in this review.
Structural counts are proxies, not precision/recall against gold graphs. More temporal edges do not establish greater factual correctness.
Different input modalities and Omni repair policy prevent intrinsic model-capability ranking.
Final task accuracy does not isolate graph-generator quality.

findings.finding: Target speaker Phoebe; Omni organization shifts its psychological conclusion to Chandler, while GPT/Gemini keep Phoebe as focal speaker.
GPT allocates2 of6 nodes to producer credits, low relevance to target emotion; Gemini instead captures utterance segments and speech pause. Omni organization mistranslates backhand as slap.
Gemini links visible smile with an audio-tagged rising/lively tone; tone not independently verified here. Omni describes a living room although frames show a populated cafe-like setting.
Omni leftward-gaze claim contradicts sampled screen-right gaze; Gemini/GPT track visible facial changes. Gemini organization also has pronoun inconsistency.
Gemini retains utterance sequence and scene-cut sequence; GPT is more sparse; Omni lacks temporal edges and gives opposite screen gaze direction.
